input.answer: Consumer prices in Canada were up 3.1% year over year in September 2026. The all-items CPI (Canada, not seasonally adjusted, 2002=100) was 170.0 in September 2026, against 164.9 in September 2025. Calculation: (170.0 − 164.9) / 164.9 = 5.1 / 164.9 = 0.0309, or 3.1% to one decimal place. Source: StatCan table 18-10-0004, Consumer Price Index, monthly, not seasonally adjusted (vector 41690973).

answer_values.label: change_pct
answer_values.description: Year-over-year change in all-items CPI, Canada (not seasonally adjusted)
